attribution: Saxton Hale is a Valve character. Community models belong to their respective authors.
notes: TF2 does not ship a Saxton Hale player model in its base VPKs (verified against tf2_misc_dir.vpk). Download a model you are allowed to use from the SFM Workshop, import its files on the Imports page and link them to this entry. Skeleton and cosmetic compatibility depend on the model you import.

name: Female Scout (FemScout)
attribution: Community model by its respective author. Based on Valve characters.
notes: Not part of TF2. Import a Female Scout (FemScout) model you are permitted to use and link it here. Official scout cosmetics only fit if the model keeps the standard TF2 scout skeleton (bip_* bone names); otherwise expect misplaced or unweighted parts.
